en.headline: Hospital Authority to open 15 family medicine clinics on Chung Yeung holiday Monday
en.dek: Services will run from 9am to 1pm and 2pm to 5pm on 19 October; patients can book by phone, eHealth or HA Go.
body: The Hospital Authority announced on Saturday that 15 Family Medicine Clinics will provide public-holiday outpatient services on Monday, the day following the Chung Yeung Festival.

The clinics are spread across Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories. Opening hours will be 9am to 1pm and 2pm to 5pm. Patients can make appointments through the telephone booking system, the eHealth app or the HA Go app.

The Authority reminded the public to maintain personal and environmental hygiene during the holiday and encouraged eligible people, especially those in high-risk groups, to get influenza vaccinations early. Non-urgent patients were advised to avoid emergency departments.

zh.headline: 醫管局公布重陽節翌日15間家庭醫學診所提供門診服務
zh.dek: 十月十九日公眾假期上午九時至一時及下午二時至五時開放，市民可經電話、醫健通或HA Go預約。
body: 醫院管理局發言人今日公布，重陽節翌日公眾假期（十月十九日）將有十五間家庭醫學診所提供公眾假期家庭醫學門診服務。
診所遍布港島、九龍及新界。服務時間為上午九時至下午一時及下午二時至下午五時。求診人士可透過電話預約系統、醫健通流動應用程式或HA Go應用程式內的預約功能預約診症。
醫管局提醒市民在假期期間注意個人及環境衞生，並呼籲合資格人士尤其高風險群組及早接種流感疫苗。非緊急病人應避免前往急症室。
